definitions.explanation: The process of seasoning ingredients before the main cooking process, typically to enhance flavor absorption and remove odors.

examples.japanese: ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{下味|したあじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}けて→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧。
examples.english: Season the meat beforehand, then grill it.

examples.japanese: {下味|したあじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{胡椒|こしょう}→胡椒：10321_koshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I used salt and pepper for the preliminary seasoning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鶏肉|とりにく}→鶏肉：02919_toriniku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{下味|したあじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{漬|つ}けて→漬ける：09861_tsukeru⟧⟦{一晩|ひとばん}→一晩：08887_hitoban⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: Marinate the chicken in the seasoning and leave it overnight.

notes:
FORMATION: ⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧ (under/preliminary) + ⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧ (taste/flavor).

COOKING CONTEXT: A fundamental Japanese cooking technique used to prepare ingredients before the main cooking process. It both deepens flavor and, for fish and meat, helps remove unwanted odors.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {下味|したあじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{付|つ}ける→付ける：00761_tsukeru⟧ (apply preliminary seasoning)
- {下味|したあじ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{漬|つ}ける→漬ける：09861_tsukeru⟧ (marinate in seasoning)
- {下味|したあじ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{染|し}み{込|こ}ませる→染み込む：07893_shimikomu⟧ (let the seasoning soak in)

TYPICAL SEASONINGS:
- ⟦{塩|しお}→塩：00887_shio⟧ (salt)
- ⟦{胡椒|こしょう}→胡椒：10321_koshou⟧ (pepper)
- ⟦{醤油|しょうゆ}→醤油：01056_shouyu⟧ (soy sauce)
- ⟦{酒|さけ}→酒：02211_sake⟧ (sake)
- ⟦{生姜|しょうが}→生姜：05191_shouga⟧ (ginger) — for removing odors
